No single trunk, rooted holdfast or biologically invented attachment. Closed volumetric fine strands lie against shale, not painted texture. Entire tuft is a specimen concept; substrate underside is artistic. Actual ROM57841 photograph shows spreading tangled fine fans and no rigid central trunk; do not imitate M.aequalis historic retouched drawing.
